info.title: BetAnalysisTool.Api
info.description:
Public API surface of the GreenSlips MLB analytics platform.

This document is published for architectural illustration only. It describes the shape of the API — paths, verbs, parameters and response contracts — and contains no implementation detail, credentials, or host information. The service is not publicly reachable and no server URL is listed.

Endpoints tagged as a dormant NBA-era surface remain routed for compatibility but resolve to placeholder services while the NBA vertical is detached.

Paths, verbs and parameters mirror the controller routing exactly. Response schemas are documented from the corresponding response records; operations without a schema return an untyped result and are documented as a bare 200.
